title: ononis natrix var. hispanica
intro: Ononis natrix var. hispanica, commonly known as the Spanish restharrow, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ononis natrix var. hispanica include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
